notes.title: Revenge of the Silent Dan is out!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Well, it's X hour and we're revealing the cards in front of you: the first official add-on for Revenge of the Boxer has been released, featuring the currently active character Silent Dan.[/h1][/b]

His name is Dan, and he's just been fired from the office where he worked as a floor cleaner. Determined not to put up with the situation, Dan embarks on a path of revenge. Dan gets in the way of colorful characters of New York reality. Revenge is coming and he knows it.

[b][h1]Game adaptation of the famous audiobook by Ozon671games![/h1][/b]

[b]BASED ON THE NOVEL:[/b] the game does not strictly follow the storyline of the original, instead it gives players a new reading of the immortal classic.

[b]An expansion for the iconic thrash game of the '00s:[/b] two internet icons come together to create explosive excitement and atomic GOOD NICE!

[b]Don't judge harshly:[/b] the game is made for fun and for people who are into it. A love message to Ozon671games for many years of labor in the field of Russian video blogging.

[b]Cult mechanics: [/b]the basis is still the same, long-time fans of “Revenge of the Boxer” won't have to get used to new controls.

Thank you to the publishers for the opportunity to release a DLC to a game beloved by millions, and of course, a HUGE thanks to the author of the work Ozon671games! Without him none of this would be possible. 

Play and don't bust your bellies!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553530/
